Read the Capalaba guide Illustrative image; not a photographed Capalaba address. Common first questions What does a safety switch do? It monitors for leakage of electrical current and cuts power when that fault is detected. A safety switch only protects the circuits connected to it and must work correctly to help protect people. Is a circuit breaker the same as a safety switch? No. A circuit breaker primarily protects wiring and appliances; a safety switch protects people against electric shock. Some devices combine both functions, so ask a licensed electrician if the board labels are unclear. Which type of smoke alarm meets Queensland's current requirements? Compliant alarms are photoelectric, interconnected and meet AS 3786-2014. The required power supply and replacement choice depend on the dwelling and existing alarm arrangement.
